notes.title: Weekly Devlog
notes.content:
🎮 Strategy Warriors, Greetings! 🐾 Another week of blazing keyboards, bug hunting, and fresh upgrades at Slap Games HQ! Let’s just say sleep was optional. 😅 Here’s what’s new in Godstone Tactics—ready? Let’s dive in!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185284/96124cf44a5b231d29f3278ca8ee8059d6701ed1.png

🌟 New Features & Improvements
🏆 ELO System Overhaul!
* Your ELO score will never drop below zero!
* Starting ELO is now 1000, and scores are multiplied by 20 for better balance.
🎮 In-Game Notification Panel Added!
* Someone sent a match invite? Friend request?
* All notifications now appear in the top-left corner!
* Click to accept or decline. 👌
⚙️ Settings Upgraded!
* Toggle animations on/off!
* Screenshake effects are now optional. Screen shake lovers, we’ve got you covered. 😌
🔊 New SFX!
* The Squirrel character now has a unique sound when thrown! 🐿️✨ A tiny hero’s farewell!

🛠 Bug Fixes & Technical Tweaks
🌐 Discovery Mode Stabilized!
* Fixed crashes when entering Discovery while matchmaking.
* Addressed issues where Discovery wouldn’t work after the first game. Explore stress-free now!
🐇 Rabbit Targeting Indicator!
* A floating arrow now hovers over rabbits!
* Arrows stay visible until the character is played, bobbing up and down—adorably tactical!
🐰 Bunny Death Glitch Fixed!
* There was a bug where a bunny didn’t “say goodbye” properly… 🙏 Fixed! Now every bunny falls heroically.
📌 Minor Adjustments & Polish
* Smoother performance thanks to code refactoring.
* Visual transition tweaks.
* Micro-changes to enhance user experience.

🎯 Growing With Our Community! Your feedback shapes Godstone Tactics! Spotted a bug? Have ideas? Join us on Discord! 👉 https://discord.gg/Zjxk3MRx
May your strategies be many and your victories plentiful! 🏆 – The Slap Games Team
